profile.name: Gayathri Boopathy
profile.title: PhD Candidate in Computer Engineering · AR/XR · AI/ML · Full-Stack
profile.tagline: I build AR-based hand-gesture and eye-gaze systems, AI-driven digital rehabilitation, and human–robot interaction at the CACT Lab, UMass Lowell.

experience.org: CACT Lab, University of Massachusetts Lowell
points: Conducting research on AR-based hand gesture recognition, eye-gaze tracking, ML/AI-driven interactive systems and XR Spatial Computing.
Developing real-time hand gesture and eye-gaze tracking models using MediaPipe and AR devices; applying MBSE and SysML for system integration.
Enabling remote control of robotic arms and mechanical systems through hand gestures and eye-gaze inputs using MQTT communication protocols.

experience.org: CACT Lab, University of Massachusetts Lowell
points: Researched Augmented Reality (AR), AI, and Digital Twin technologies using Magic Leap for real-time hand tracking.
Built Unity (OpenXR, C#) interactive AR systems integrated with Python-based MediaPipe hand pose estimation.
Applied ML models (Random Forest, KNN, Decision Trees, GMM) & LLMs for gesture classification & biomechanical analysis.
Developed supervised and unsupervised models to classify hand movements such as flexion, extension, open, and close.
Developed and optimized B2C/B2B eCommerce platforms using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SASS.
Improved API performance by ~40% through caching strategies, database optimization, and secure authentication mechanisms.
Designed and deployed CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Git, reducing deployment time by 50%.
Built microservices-based backends for product catalog, checkout, and order management using Node.js and Spring Boot.
Led frontend performance optimization using Redux, Webpack, Babel, npm, and Yarn, reducing page load time by ~30%.
Automated testing and verification using Python, saving 15-17 hours/week and reducing manual effort by 70%.

projects.name: TheraXP – AI-Powered Gamified Digital Rehab Platform
points: Developing an AI-powered gamified rehabilitation platform integrating AR/XR, computer vision, HMI, and MBSE for personalized, data-driven therapy.
Designing a scalable healthcare ecosystem for hand, eye, & full-body rehabilitation using multimodal sensing, AI-based assessment, & clinician feedback.
Applying enterprise architecture and MBSE to integrate real-time biomechanical sensing, digital therapeutics, and gamification for accessible rehabilitation.

projects.name: Real-Time AR Object Detection System
points: Built a real-time object detection pipeline using TensorFlow (shape detection) and YOLO (object recognition).
Streamed live camera frames via WebSockets for backend inference and result synchronization.
Integrated detected objects into the AR scene with spatially anchored visual overlays.

projects.name: AR-Based Robotic Arm Control using Hand Gestures
points: Goal: an intuitive AR-based human-machine interaction system that enables touchless control of robotic arms using hand gestures.
Designed an AR-driven system to control robotic arms and mechanical systems using Unity, MediaPipe, and MQTT.
Implemented gesture-based authentication and adaptable hand gesture control mechanisms.
Applied SysML and MBSE to model system architecture, data flow, and store structured gesture and control data.

projects.name: Customizable Hand Gesture Classification with Machine Learning
points: Goal: a personalized hand gesture classification framework that adapts to individual user biomechanics for improved accuracy in AR.
Applied K-means clustering to classify hand gestures and derive adaptive threshold values.
Validated adaptable gesture thresholds through real-time AR-based virtual task analysis.
Used SysML and MBSE methodologies to model hand gesture data, system behavior, and parameter storage for adaptive learning.

projects.name: Full-Stack Web Apps: Carpool, Event Management & Digital Library
points: Goal: scalable full-stack web applications for ride-sharing, scheduling, and digital commerce.
Developed a corporate calendar application with event management using React.js, Node.js, and MySQL.
Built a carpool web app enabling ride creation, search, matching, and scheduling using React.js, Node.js, REST APIs, and MySQL.
Implemented user authentication, role-based access, and real-time updates for efficient ride coordination.
Built a library bookstore platform with Amazon/Flipkart-style PLP and PDP pages.

projects.name: IoT-Based Temperature Monitoring System
points: Goal: an end-to-end IoT solution for real-time environmental data acquisition & visualization across web and mobile.
Designed an IoT system using Raspberry Pi Pico W with BLE to collect real-time temperature sensor data.
Implemented BLE communication and RESTful APIs to transmit sensor data from edge devices to cloud storage.
Developed a cross-platform Android mobile application using React Native for real-time data monitoring.
Built a React.js web dashboard for live data visualization and analytics.

projects.name: Melanoma Detection using Deep Learning & IoT
points: Goal: early detection of melanoma using deep learning and IoT-based medical imaging for real-time diagnostic support.
Developed a CNN-based melanoma detection model achieving ~87% accuracy.
Integrated IoT-based imaging with a React.js GUI for real-time diagnostics.
